نتفلسف (form IIq)
# نَتَفَلْسَفُ (natafalsafu) /na.ta.fal.sa.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
# نَتَفَلْسَفَ (natafalsafa) /na.ta.fal.sa.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
# نَتَفَلْسَفْ (natafalsaf) /na.ta.fal.saf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَلْسَفَ (tafalsafa)
